author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Looking at the portfolio, meeting with the investment committee in an hour. we're looking at adjusting the portfolio ahead of earnings season. search for recent my news and analyst coverage, then check my portfolio positions and values. Pay the $750 quarterly bookkeeping fee via PayPal to bookkeeping@firm2.com. Browse the MU stock page for its current price and check recent MU news for any material updates. Email a portfolio report to betty.clark@sunvalleyfunds.com. Include MU's current stock price in the email, quoting the exact dollar figure from the quote page. Mention AMD's beta value using the precise number from Key Statistics. Note AVGO's approximate market capitalization - copy the exact figure as displayed.
